title: First translation track (non-patient-facing content)
context: This backlog task pilots the first translation track for non-patient-facing curriculum content, building on instructor-303's translation-readiness pass. A per-language reviewer is needed; patient-facing translation remains out-of-scope/high-risk. The target language is not yet enumerated in the plan, so this is one representative task pending a named language + reviewer.
objective: Pilot a first translation track for non-patient-facing content once a target language and per-language reviewer are secured, preserving plain-language structure and surfacing all attributions.
acceptanceCriteria: Covers non-patient-facing content only; patient-facing material remains out-of-scope/high-risk and is not translated.
A named per-language reviewer reviews the translation for accuracy and plain language before delivery.
Source structure/attribution preserved; both tracks' code remains executable; CI green.
Translation licensed compatibly with the source content (CC-BY-4.0 for the project's own CC-BY content; never relicense a copyrighted source).
Representative task only: concrete per-language tasks expand once a target language + reviewer are confirmed (do not fabricate languages).
resources: PLAN.md (binding cancer guardrails / Data, licensing & compliance)
